name: skillvault-installation
title: SkillVault Installation
description: Manage installed SkillVault copies. Use /skillvault-installation or /sv-installation list, install, update, or uninstall. Replaces skillvault-install, skillvault-list, skillvault-uninstall and /sv-install, /sv-list, /sv-uninstall. List defaults to installed copies; list catalog inspects sources. Does not edit SkillVault source or application code; skillvault-authoring owns skill authoring.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Primary action; omitted means read-only list. Compatibility aliases remain in SKILL.md. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: skillOrFolderOrKeyword
inputs.description: Name, folder, or keyword used to install or update catalog skills. Omit to explore; use update to refresh approved managed installed copies.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Optional second positional target: global (~/.copilot/skills), project (.github/skills), or session (current AI session only). Defaults to the resolved skill's install.defaultScope, then project.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Optional third positional version: latest or a tag in v#.#.# format. Defaults to latest.

inputs.name: repoPath
inputs.description: Explicit verified source checkout through --repo <path>. Otherwise use the known C:\repos\skillvault checkout; never silently select a cache or another session's clone. Separate from the target project.
